introduction: Claude Overhead can now hide outside the notch, for fullscreen video and anything else where it would distract, and come back with one click.

cards.title: Hide outside the notch
cards.summary: A new eye button beside the usage readout in the open notch hides everything beside the camera: no character, activity line, signals or glow, in every layout and in fullscreen apps.
details: Hidden, the notch does not open on hover, a failure or an update notice. Click inside the notch to open it, and click the eye again to show Claude Overhead as before.
Sessions are still watched, and the sounds you turned on still play.
A permission request or question is never hidden, because Claude is waiting for it. Lock Mode still decides whether the notch opens on one.
Hidden is separate from the layouts and from Lock Mode, and is kept across restarts. It is also in Settings, under General, and in the notch's right-click menu.

image.alt: The top of the screen in a fullscreen video. Above, shown: its mark and icons beside the notch. Below, hidden: nothing beside the notch.
